question: What is the absolute percent difference between the total federal expenditures reported in February 1938 and January 1939, rounded to the nearest tenths place in millions of dollars?
raw_response:
The standard interpretation of "percent difference between A and B" rounded to nearest tenth, using the first-mentioned (Feb 1938) as the base, gives 31.2%.

The total federal expenditures: Feb 1938 = 528 million, Jan 1939 = 693 million. Absolute percent difference = |693−528|/528 × 100 = 31.25 → 31.2%.

<FINAL_ANSWER>31.2</FINAL_ANSWER>
